research_stage: Development measurement preparation, not phenomenon confirmation
new_capability: Export blank primary-endpoint review materials from a sealed staged batch without conditioning inclusion on downstream execution success
measurement_rules: Require externally pinned archive and plan digests; verify every manifested file and reject extras
Verify first-generation request equals the frozen pre-result contract prompt and response hash links to it
Retain all twelve planned slots, including unstarted slots and later failures
Unavailable labels remain unfilled, never converted to false or zero
Preserve raw contract text, including invalid-format and non-stop responses; do not repair it
Hide price, history ID, later outcome and pair IDs from reviewer items; preserve them in a separate organizer mapping
Do not claim complete blinding because verbatim response content may reveal condition clues
Judge whole-contract meaning, distinguish field placement from substantive omission or contradiction
Keep scripted-source markings and blank reviewer independence/exposure disclosures
Exporter saves its own source and digest with a sealed output journal

verification.integration_case: Real scripted batch orchestration with a valid first contract followed by a deliberately wrong provider ID; export retains that contract and all twelve slots
verification.scope: Synthetic temporary archives, mocked replies and local file integrity checks only

scientific_limits: No controlled cache-price effect has been observed by this work
Blank review export does not establish request clarity, reference correctness or reviewer independence
This exports the pre-result contract endpoint only; linked program and cache-use judgments need separate evidence
The proposed diagnostic contains two exposed target tasks, not twelve independent tasks
Strong-baseline residual benefit and generalization remain unproven
next_action: Keep live execution gated; finish separately scoped trajectory/program evidence review and connect adjudicated labels to fixed-pair descriptive accounting without inventing labels
